scripts.generate:images: bun run scripts/generate_image_variants.ts && bun run scripts/sync_blog_assets.ts
scripts.generate:mermaid: FORCE_MERMAID_DIAGRAM_GENERATION=true astro sync && bun run scripts/sync_blog_assets.ts
scripts.dev: bun run dev:tls && bun run generate:images && bun run scripts/run_dev.ts
scripts.build: bun run generate:images && astro build && bun run validate:static
scripts.preview: LIGHTHOUSE_IF_CHANGED=true bun run lighthouse && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc --https-key-path .dev-localhost-key.pem --https-cert-path .dev-localhost-cert.pem --log-level warn
scripts.lighthouse: bun run dev:tls && bun run scripts/run_lighthouse.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run tsc -b && bun run astro check
scripts.check: bun ./node_modules/ultracite/dist/index.js check && bun run check:imports && bun run typecheck && bun run lint:tailwind
scripts.ci: bun run check && bun run test && bun run lighthouse
